description: Append an authenticated challenge to one public Hourkeeper decision for moderator review. Use decision_id from inspect_hourkeeper_reasoning/get_hourkeeper_history and provide the required contribution/idempotency key. It does not overwrite the decision or guarantee reversal. Use challenge_cassie_claim for a claim rather than an Hourkeeper decision.

claim_id.description: Existing public claim ID; required by challenge_cassie_claim and support_cassie_claim. Obtain it from public mesh state or a search result.

confidence.description: Optional contributor-estimated confidence from 0 to 1; defaults to 0.5. It is not independently verified probability.

contribution.description: Required attributed note text, 8–4000 characters. Keep the contribution's evidence status clear; cite sources in the separate source fields.

decision_id.description: Required public Hourkeeper decision ID from the history/detail tool.

evidence_relationship.description: Optional relationship of the cited evidence to the referenced claim: supports, challenges or contextualizes.

excerpt.description: Optional exact source excerpt, at most 500 characters; do not reconstruct missing text.

idempotency_key.description: Required stable caller-generated key (8–160 characters) for retry-safe recording. Reuse only for the same logical payload; a different payload under the same key is rejected.

knowledge_layer.description: Optional knowledge-layer label from the listed values. Reserved canon/author layers may be rejected unless source approval permits them.

parent_claim_id.description: Optional public claim ID that this note explicitly extends or relates to.

parent_note_id.description: Optional existing note ID to reply to; for a shared note use the original note ID returned by its author/read flow.

reasoning_summary.description: Optional concise rationale, up to 2000 characters; this is an attributed explanation, not a request to disclose private chain-of-thought.

request_publication.description: Whether to request publication/review; defaults to false. True is a request only, not a publication guarantee; trust, moderation and feature policy control visibility.

signature.description: Optional caller-supplied signature envelope. A self-supplied signature is not treated as independent verification.

source_label.description: Optional human-readable source title or label, up to 160 characters.

source_type.description: Optional classification for the cited source. Choose the closest listed value; do not label interpretation as canon.

source_url.description: Optional absolute URL of the source actually consulted, up to 1000 characters; do not guess citations.

task_id.description: Optional public unresolved-task ID from get_open_cassie_questions or the mesh state.

name: challenge_hourkeeper_decision
title: Challenge an Hourkeeper decision
